installCommand: if [ ! -d flutter ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1; fi && flutter/bin/flutter --version
buildCommand: flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && flutter/bin/flutter create . --platforms=web && flutter/bin/flutter pub get && flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_URL=$API_URL
